observation: broodPresentation builds the live swarm brood through vfx.createBroodPresentation. The scene graph can hold hidden sf-swarm-brood nodes even with no bodies. A round that never leaves the boot plate has no live brood to read. The round-7 census lists no brood names and no brood entities.
decision: No builder edit. No live brood was in the fight, because the fight did not start.
next: Orchestrator can judge brood bodies from a live swarm round. This pass does not have that frame.
